About.welcomeP1: Abschleppdienst Direkt, led by our experienced team in Bochum, is your reliable partner for breakdown recovery, towing, and nationwide vehicle transport.
About.welcomeP2: For over 10 years, we have been transporting, securing, and transferring vehicles of all types in Bochum, North Rhine-Westphalia, and across Germany – always with maximum care and personal dedication.
About.welcomeP3: Our company expertise lies in gentle towing for engine failure or accidents, scheduled vehicle transfers from point A to B, and professional roadside jump-starts.
About.welcomeP4: Our transport vehicle is equipped with a modern flatbed featuring a flat approach angle, a high-capacity electric winch, and certified VDI 2700 load securing systems to carry all vehicle types up to 3.5 tonnes safely.
About.detailsTitle: Abschleppdienst Direkt for Every Situation – More About Us
About.detailsP1: Our dedicated team in Bochum is your premier contact for professional towing services, rapid roadside assistance, and careful vehicle transfers. We stand by you with high competence, 10 years of road experience, and state-of-the-art equipment. You speak directly with our driver Adam and dedicated dispatch team.
About.detailsP2: With us, you have a partner working safely, carefully, and above all reliably. Transparency is paramount: we offer fair, fixed rates with no hidden fees and document every step properly.
